title: What If a Wildfire Created Its Own Storm? Australia's Did

scenes.text: What if a wildfire built its own thunderstorm? In Australia, the smoke climbed 35 kilometers.
In 2019 and 2020, the fires burned over 5.8 million hectares, and the heat spun up towering fire clouds.
On December 29 to 31 alone, 32 separate fire thunderstorms erupted in what researchers called a super outbreak.
Those plumes put about three times more particles into the stratosphere than any fire cloud recorded before.
By particle count, that matched some of the strongest volcanic eruptions of the past 25 years.
The stratosphere warmed about 0.7 degrees Celsius, the biggest jump since Pinatubo in 1991, and it lasted about four months.

description:
What if a wildfire built its own storm?
Australia's 2019 to 2020 fires launched smoke 35 kilometers up, with a particle punch on par with major volcanic eruptions.
